Both solid charge arrows point left; the lower one slopes slightly upward-left. The dashed curved arrow links the lower-left small plus circle toward the upper small plus circle and retains its upward-right arrowhead. Solid/dashed and hollow/filled distinctions are unchanged.

The full original diagram, including fine scan irregularities and finite stroke ends, is inside the unchanged native box. The new crop contains neither caption fragments nor adjacent prose and clips no instructional ink.

All three curves retain their original finite endpoints and solid styles. No grid, numbered ticks, data dots or inferred numerical values are introduced. Every label and incidental original mark is retained without codepoint substitution.

The unchanged native box includes all three panels and the lowest subpart label. All four margins are clear original source pixels; neither the adjacent caption nor surrounding prose enters the crop, and no curve, arrow, axis, endpoint or label is clipped.
